plate_comment: Builds the transmit descriptor of DM8 (header 0xfed000: PGN 65232 Test Results for Non-continuously Monitored Systems) (was cm848_initJ1939EngineControlBuffer)
Builds the transmit descriptor of EBC1 (header 0xf00100: PGN 61441 Electronic Brake Controller 1; ETC1 is 61442) (was cm848_initJ1939Etc1ControlBuffer)
Builds the transmit descriptor of PGN 65279 (header 0xfeff00), the water in fuel indicator (was cm848_initJ1939SafetyStatusBuffer)
Sends PGN 65279, the water in fuel indicator: 0xff when the water in fuel algorithm is disabled, else 0xfd with fault bit 56 (water in fuel) set or 0xfc (was cm848_j1939SendSafetyStatusMessage)
Builds the EC1 payload (buildPgn65251EngineConfiguration1Payload) and sends PGN 65251 when the transmit slot is free (was cm848_sendFaultTimerMessage)

The EC1 send-on-change test (J1939-71): copies the payload to j1939_pgn65251_payload_previous, rebuilds it and compares each speed (cm848_hasWordChangedByTenPercent) and percent torque (cm848_hasByteChangedByTenPercent) with its previous value; a change of 10 % or more sends the message (was cm848_processFaultMessageTiming)
Returns 1 when a 16-bit value changed by 10 % or more of its previous value (or from 0 to non-zero): |new - old| x 10 / old >= 1 (was cm848_faultCounterDecrement)
Returns 1 when an 8-bit value changed by 10 % or more of its previous value (or from 0 to non-zero) (was cm848_faultCounterIncrement)
Sends the J1939 acknowledgement (PGN 59392, header 0xe8ff00) with the negative acknowledgement control byte (was cm848_sendJ1939NegativeAck)
